senses.zh_definition: 【专有名词】Hackus，电影《蓝精灵2》中的角色名；未核实为具有普通词义的标准马来语词。
senses.en_definition: A proper name borne by a character in The Smurfs 2; not verified as a standard Malay common word.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi salah satu watak dalam filem The Smurfs 2; bukan kata umum bahasa Melayu yang telah disahkan.
senses.nuances: Sony 的官方资料确认 Hackus 与 Vexy 是该片角色。输入缺少上下文，因此这里只提供一个已核实的专名解释，不能据此断定原始词例必指该角色。下列是自然的专名组合示例，未证实为高频搭配；不应生造“黑客”等普通词义。[Sony Pictures：The Smurfs 2](https://www.sonypictures.com/corp/press_releases/2013/06_13/061313_smurfs.html)

etymology.historical_story: Hackus appears in Sony Pictures’ publicity for The Smurfs 2 as the name of a character introduced alongside Vexy. This establishes a cultural reference, rather than a Malay lexical origin. The cited material does not explain how the name was coined. Its spelling therefore provides no reliable basis for inventing Malay roots, affixes or an ordinary dictionary meaning. [Sony Pictures](https://www.sonypictures.com/corp/press_releases/2013/06_13/061313_smurfs.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Hackus 与 Vexy 配对记成《蓝精灵2》角色名；不要仅凭开头 hack 就联想到“黑客”的词义。
